messages:
alex: Heads-up — Atlas (enterprise POC) asking for a 3-month dedicated commit with a POC carveout. They want 4x A100 baseline, autoscale to 8x A100 for bursts, and a 30-day high-burst window. Asking if we can: 1) discount first-month commit 40% for the POC, 2) allow unused burst hours to rollover as credits, and 3) waive surge surcharge for the POC period. Can we get deal-desk + finance eyes?
maria: Thanks Alex. Quick context — Atlas is in security review, wants predictable billing during POC so their security/legal sign-off goes smoothly. If we do a carveout, they probably will commit to 12 months afterwards.
sasha: From solutions: technically fine. Autoscale policy can be limited to a single region and capped by GPU-hours. We can do a canary for burst to ensure stable latency. Question for finance: what's the approval threshold for a 40% first-month discount + rollover credits?
ryan: Finance: anything that changes the standard committed rate needs deal-desk approval. Rollover credits are uncommon but OK if limited. Need the proposed contract language and expected ARR tradeoffs. Rough calc: 4x A100 baseline ~ $X/day (internal rate), autoscale to 8x adds ~75% variable cost during burst. If they want waiver of surge surcharge for the POC, request needs exec sign-off.
deal-desk-bot: @channel Please file a deal-desk ticket with: customer name, commit GPU type & quantity, POC window, proposed discounts, legal carveouts. Template: /deal-desk new --customer Atlas --commit "4x A100" --burst "up to 8x A100 for 30 days" --discount "40% first month" --rollover "max 300 GPU-hours" --surcharge-waive yes
maria: I'm attaching the POC timeline in the ticket. Also propose we limit rollover credits to 300 GPU-hours and expire after 60 days post-POC. That keeps economics sane.
sasha: Proposed terms (for quick copy):
```
- Baseline: 4x A100 reserved for 3 months
- Burst: up to 8x A100 for a single 30-day window during POC
- Pricing: 40% discount on month 1 of commit only
- Rollover: up to 300 GPU-hours convertible to account credit, expires 60 days after POC
- Surge surcharge: waived for the 30-day burst window only
- Autoscale: region-locked, canary 48h before full burst
- SLA: standard Dedicated SLA applies; no premium SLA during POC
```
ryan: That looks reasonable. Two asks: (1) add a clause — "burst usage beyond 300 GPU-hours billed at standard burst rate", (2) legal to approve rollover credit language.
alex: A few negotiation points from Atlas: they'd like the rollover to be refundable if they convert to 12-month commitment. That's a conversion credit — should we offer a prorated conversion credit instead of refund?
sasha: Yes — offering a conversion credit is safer. Example: unused rollover hours -> credit applied to first invoice of 12-month commit at standard rate. No cash refunds.
maria: I can present that. Also asking for an internal exception to allow the 40% first-month discount without exec-level sign-off because ACV is below $250k. If the deal-desk needs it, escalate but note the conversion probability is high.
deal-desk-bot: @ryan Please confirm: approval required from Deal Desk for discounts >30% or non-standard rollover terms. Submit ticket and tag @deal-desk.
ryan: Confirmed. I can approve up to 35% on a case-by-case with finance lead signoff. For 40% we need deal-desk + GTM manager (cc @maria).
alex: Ok — I'll file the deal-desk ticket now with Sasha's proposed terms and request a 40% exception; include conversion-credit language and the 300 GPU-hour cap. Also note POC timeline and expected upsell to 12 months.
maria: Thanks. If deal-desk approves we'll loop in legal to finalize the rollover wording. Also coordinate with eng-run to schedule the canary burst day (48h notice).
sasha: I'll prepare a short runbook for the canary and tagging of metrics to watch (latency, OOMs, queue depth).
ryan: When ticket's in, tag me and I'll queue finance review. Also include model family and expected token throughput so we can estimate cost accurately.
alex: Filed: /deal-desk/1835001234 — included all terms, PSR, and expected ARR. Tagging @ryan @sasha.
(deal-desk-bot reaction: :white_check_mark:)
maria: Great — keeping this thread for updates. Once approved we finalize the POC SOW and send Atlas the T&Cs. :thumbsup:
